Name: Eusebius of Caesarea
Summary: Bishop of Caesarea in the early fourth century and the first great historian of the Christian church.
Contribution: His Ecclesiastical History gathered letters, martyr accounts, and lists of bishops and writings from the apostles to his own day, preserving sources that would otherwise be lost and giving later historians their framework for the early church.
KeyWorks: Ecclesiastical History; Life of Constantine; Preparation for the Gospel
